items.title: Explicit asymptotically good relaxed locally correctable codes with near-log-squared query complexity
items.author: Gil Cohen; Tal Yankovitz
items.source_version: CCC2024, LIPIcs volume300 article8, 2024-07-15, official corrected PDF pp.8:1-8:16; editable author-text transcription
items.difficulty_reason: The authors weaken global local testability to testability near the code, handle irregular expander degrees by truncating high-degree constraints, and combine a hierarchy of vicinity testers. The quantitative expansion/rate/query tradeoffs form a nonroutine explicit coding construction; all local proof support remains uncounted.

proof_spans.label: complete author Lemma9, Claim10, Proposition11 and Theorem12 construction/proofs, pp.8:10-8:14

contexts.label: necessary author code/RLCC/VLTC/unique-neighbor definitions and prior expander theorem, pp.8:8-8:10
